limitations: A headless public browser may be served anti-bot or regional variants; those are recorded as environment outcomes, not product defects.
Market-state contradictions require at least two independent public contexts before promotion to a defect.
Accessibility observations are bounded to rendered DOM, accessibility tree, and keyboard focus in the tested public pages.
One laboratory navigation per profile and route is not a field performance percentile.
